island.brief:
Plan Castaway Coast, a 256 by 256 island. Use warm timber, pale fabric, dark weathered wood and stone, with a protected buffer 32 blocks outside the project.
Ocean Border: water 256 by 256, 1 block high, elevation -2, border 16 blocks wide.
Land: terrain 224 by 192, 36 blocks high, elevation -12.
West Bay: water 32 by 24, 4 blocks high, elevation -4, west.
East Bay: water 32 by 24, 4 blocks high, elevation -4, east.
Beach: terrain 224 by 12, 2 blocks high, south. Beach depth 6 to 12 blocks.
Ridge: terrain 64 by 48, 32 blocks high, north. Slopes or stairs connect destinations.
Cove: water 24 by 16, 8 blocks high, elevation -8, east. Depth 4 to 8 blocks.
Woodland: grove 64 by 48, 12 blocks high, west. Three separated patches.
Cave: cave 24 by 12, 4 blocks high, elevation 4, north. Passage 24 blocks long with chamber 10 by 8 and head clearance 2 blocks. Connects to Ridge, Beacon.
Beach Camp: clearing 32 by 24, 3 blocks high, south. Three distinct awnings, storage and cooking corner. Objects: awning, bench, table, shelf, radio-like console, supply crate cluster, bollard, wreck rib. Radio and furniture are decorative. Connects to Dock, Research Station.
Communal Pavilion: open pavilion 14 by 10, 6 blocks high, elevation 4, south. Connects to Beach Camp.
Research Station: building 24 by 16, 6 blocks high, elevation 4, east. One-storey shallow asymmetric roof. Three rooms: workshop, bunkroom, records room. Native: doors, crafting table, chests, beds, lamps. Connects to Beach Camp.
Beacon: tower 9 by 9, 18 blocks high, elevation 12, north. Rooms: lantern room. Objects: internal stair, railings. Connects to Lookout, Cave.
Lookout: terrain 12 by 12, 3 blocks high, elevation 28, north. Connects to Beacon.
Dock: dock 24 by 5, 2 blocks high, south. Wider landing and shore connection. Objects: bollard, supply crate cluster. Connects to Beach Camp.
Wreck: wreck 28 by 9, 5 blocks high, west. Two exposed ribs. Rooms: cargo cavity. Objects: wreck rib. Decorative, not a vehicle. Connects to Beach Camp.
Main Path: path 96 by 3, 1 block high. Connects to Dock, Beach Camp, Research Station.
Trails: path 96 by 2, 1 block high, north. Connects to Beach Camp, Cave, Beacon.
Junctions: decoration 6 by 6, 3 blocks high. Three signposted junctions.

town.brief:
Plan Highwater, a 192 by 192 alpine river town. Use stone, spruce timber, dark roofs and warm windows with a protected buffer 32 blocks outside the project.
River: water 12 by 192, 4 blocks high, elevation -4. Water channel 8 to 12 blocks wide.
West Slope: terrain 64 by 48, 28 blocks high, west. Slopes rise 12 to 28 blocks.
East Slope: terrain 64 by 48, 28 blocks high, east.
Market: clearing 28 by 20, 1 block high, west. Four stalls. Objects: stall, counter, bench, lamppost, pantry shelves, planter, static wheel, signpost. Connects to Road Bridge, Inn.
Inn: building 20 by 16, 10 blocks high, west. Two-storey. Rooms: common room, kitchen, four upstairs rooms. Objects: internal stairs. Native: doors, chests, beds, crafting table. Connects to Market.
Mill: building 16 by 12, 8 blocks high, east. Objects: static decorative wheel. No working mill mechanism. Connects to Road Bridge.
Lodge: building 18 by 14, 10 blocks high, east. Steep roof. Rooms: loft. Objects: loft stairs. Connects to Footbridge.
Footbridge: bridge 16 by 3, 2 blocks high, elevation 1. Connects to River, Lodge, Terraces.
Road Bridge: bridge 16 by 5, 2 blocks high, elevation 1. Connects to River, Market, Mill.
Terraces: terrain 48 by 36, 12 blocks high, west. Three terraces with retaining walls and vegetation. Connects to Footbridge, Market.
Orchard: grove 24 by 24, 10 blocks high, east.
Town Path: path 96 by 3, 1 block high. Connects to Market, Inn, Mill, Lodge, Terraces.
Bank Walk: path 96 by 2, 1 block high. Connects to Road Bridge, Mill.
